scope: Sixteen whole-token adjective comparative or superlative defects in the four Latin sources: one dalših, two unaccented pozdnejš- forms, all six adjective ranějš-/ranjejš- forms, and all seven truncated najobć- superlative forms. All targets occur in the base papers.
choice: Normalize by exact sentence grammar and official lexical family: dalših to daljših for further/subsequent; pozdnejš- to pozdnějš-; the complete adjective ranějš-/ranjejš- family to inflected ranš- while preserving the distinct adverb raněje; and the incomplete najobć- forms to inflected najobćejš-.
motivation: The target families are directly prescribed by the official dictionary and comparative grammar, and every site is confirmed by the German meaning authority. This closes four small but visible mixed-paradigm residues without touching valid adverbs, positive adjectives, or unrelated comparative senses.
alternatives_rejected: Retaining dalših under the generic daleky to dalši grammar rule was rejected because this sentence means further/subsequent investigations, for which the official lexical comparator is daljši; it does not mean physically farther.
Merely accenting ranjejš- to ranějš- was rejected because the exact official adjective comparative headword is ranši. The separate official adverb raněje remains untouched.

Reading the seven najobć- forms as ordinary positive adjectives or adverbs was rejected because each governs or predicates a noun and the German has an explicit allgemeinste/allgemeinsten superlative.
A broad stem-level replacement was rejected in favor of the sixteen audited whole-token sites so valid obći, raněje, pozdněje, dalje and other paradigms remain byte-exact.

evidence.official_dictionary: Official isv_words_list.csv, 7993414 bytes, SHA-256 072DE8E512EB386780D199FBD6F0ACF2639D3096EA920F1AF2D0AFCC5535E842: row 1872 / ID 3032 daljši, type 1, further/farther; row 9068 / ID 1000 obći, type 1; row 11988 / ID 11106 pozdnějši, type 1, later; row 13366 / ID 4060 ranši, type 1, earlier. The national comparator columns span West, South and East Slavic and preserve the exact semantic distinctions used here.
evidence.official_grammar: Official adjectives.md, 8142 bytes, SHA-256 184348005ACB532868DAEB35DBFB7A8E05A493D550B4D6FA2E1A3BCFC906D84F: line 63 gives comparative -ějši/-ejši, line 67 gives the shorter -ši class, and line 87 forms the superlative by adding naj- to the comparative. Thus obći gives obćejši/najobćejši, while exact dictionary headwords control the daljši, pozdnějši and ranši lexical families.
evidence.german_authority: German authority ED0014 noether.tex, 2154011 bytes, SHA-256 EE226847656BC4D65EDDA9E9BF9BB1D25797C0C6D672D267D94A97FD88C7AD58. Exact representative controls: lines 3666, 8507, 8513, 8833, 9051 and 9080 have allgemeinsten/allgemeinste; lines 6380, 8886, 10409 and 10475 have früheren; line 7694 has späteren Literatur; line 17449 has späteren Anwendungen; and line 19042 has weiteren Untersuchungen.
evidence.semantic_audit: All sixteen sites were read in full sentence context. Seven najobć- sites mean most general forms, expression, transformations, solutions, groups or I; six ran- sites mean earlier result/work/case/items/basis; two pozdnějš- sites mean later literature/applications; and dalših means further investigations. No spatial-far, merely-general, adverbial-earlier, or proper-name occurrence is present.
evidence.edition_controls: Before the edit the exact canonical controls include daljših 12, pozdnějših 4, najobćejše 19, Najobćejše 7, najobćejši 2 and najobćejših 9. The six adjective earlier sites were the entire noncanonical family; the valid adverb raněje is separate and protected.
evidence.protected_domains: No target occurs in a TeX comment, control name, label, citation key, URL, math expression, bibliography identity, or foreign-language/title argument. One earlier-work occurrence and one most-general-solutions occurrence are in editable explanatory footnotes, not protected quotations.

validation.coverage: The thirteen exact source spellings total sixteen tokens at the declared locators; all are replayed and all become zero.
validation.postcondition: Every canonical target increment matches its mapped source count. Valid raněje, pozdněje, dalje and positive obći forms remain unchanged.
validation.structure: Only the base source changes, by thirteen UTF-8 bytes. Line count, raw brace counts, ordered TeX-control stream and math-delimiter stream are invariant; the other three sources are byte-identical.
validation.reproducibility: The deterministic applicator binds all four input and output byte counts and SHA-256 hashes, exact token histograms and exact line/column/token locators, and refuses drift.
